title: Send a photo on WhatsApp
aliases: how do i send a picture on whatsapp
send my family a photo on whatsapp
put a photo in a whatsapp chat

steps.instruction: Tap the chat with the person you want to send the photo to.
Tap the photo you want to send.
Tap the paper plane icon to send the photo.

source_note: WhatsApp for iPhone, October 2026 layout on iOS 26/27, English. Assumes an existing individual chat and photo access already allowed. The attachment menu may say Photos or Photo & Video Library; the picker may require Next before the preview. Check flagged steps on the installed version. Documentation review only; not checked on a phone. Source: https://faq.whatsapp.com/453914586839706/?cms_platform=iphone
